## Why it matters

Scientific Writing is a curated list of tools, templates, and tutorials for academic writing beyond LaTeX, especially with Markdown and Jupyter-based workflows.

It is useful for historians building reproducible writing setups that combine prose, citations, notebooks, and conversion tools in a plain-text environment.
